audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers give Kayle rows 1, 2, 5 and 6 and Skill on 0, 3, 4, which contradicts the packet chart (Karma 0-4) and the mirror audit (kayle__karma rows 0-4 Karma, 5-6 Kayle). It also contradicts the prose: whys[0..4] and the early/mid text already describe Karma owning every stage to level 6.
audit.why: Karma's Inner Flame is 950 range with Mantra available from level 1; Kayle's autos are melee until Divine Ascent's ranged tier. Kayle's 55.59% comes from stages 5-6, not the laning phase.
audit.corrected: phases[0..4].side and win[0..4] set to Karma; rows 5-6 stay Kayle. Proposed as five matched full/content pairs.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 why is generic ("Level 6 / 11 / 16 are the actual matchups") and gives no cooldown. Divine Judgment is 160s at rank 1 and is defensive, not a kill button, against an enchanter.
audit.why: Mirror audit already rewrote the Karma-side level 6 row with the 160s figure; the two sides must state the same fact.
audit.corrected: Level 6 why rewritten with the 160s cooldown and the fact that Karma still pre-empts the ranged autos with Mantra-Q plus shield.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal anywhere, though Mantra-W (Focused Resolve) heals Karma and E shields on top. Focused Resolve's 12s flat cooldown and Inner Flame's 950 range are never stated, so the 'wait for X' advice has no numbers.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags needs-antiheal for this pairing; Focused Resolve is a tether that breaks on line-of-sight/range, which is the decisive interaction and only vaguely gestured at.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds added to the Nashor's spike goal; Focused Resolve's flat 12s and Inner Flame's 950 range written into the level rows.

audit.why: 55.59% over 1065 games, consistent with a scaling win.

audit.whatIsWrong: suspectNames flags "Save Divine Judgment" in late as a probable wrong name.
audit.why: Divine Judgment is Kayle's real R name in the kit file. False positive; left alone.

edits.before: You are the weakest level 1 in the game — pay rent quietly. Identify how Karma contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: You are the weakest level 1 in the game — pay rent quietly. Inner Flame out-ranges your melee autos at 950 — soak XP and give up the hard creeps.

edits.before: E-poke softens his step-ups while you scale. Only take the trade when Karma's Focused Resolve is down.
edits.after: Her E shield eats your chip and drifts her out. Only step up when Focused Resolve (12s) is spent.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Karma must walk into your range.
edits.after: Mantra is hers from level 1: RQ roots you at 950 for a gank. Keep the wave near your side and never walk into that tether.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Focused Resolve's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Still her window: W sustain and your Q shred are online but her poke wins extended trades. Farm behind the wave; never face Mantra-Q low.

edits.before: Level 6 / 11 / 16 are the actual matchups — everything before is stalling. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Karma's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Divine Judgment is 160s at rank 1 and it is defensive, not a kill button — she still pre-empts your new ranged autos with Mantra-Q and shields.

edits.before: Weather the poke — survive his Focused Resolve window and out-scale everything. Kayle wins the Focused Resolve cooldown windows.
edits.after: Weather the poke — survive her Focused Resolve window and out-scale everything. Kayle wins the windows once Nashor's lands.

edits.before: Hit your Nashor's + ranged-auto spike so your Starfire (E) missing-health on-hit out-trades her shield regen
edits.after: Hit Nashor's plus Grievous Wounds so Starfire (E) missing-health on-hit out-paces her Mantra-W heal and shield regen

notes: Level chart flipped rows 0-4 to Karma in matched full/content pairs, matching the packet chart, the existing prose, and the already-audited mirror.
